prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Choose Path Persona Showcase: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout displaying persona focus cards for companion types.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Select Your Ideal Desktop Companion Style", "body": "Pick how active and social you want your companion to be during your work day.", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Focus Companion vs Playful Partner", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Account Sync Safety Flow: Reorder sign_in to follow path selection while adding explicit account cloud sync assurances.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to Cloud", "body": "Signing in preserves your companion's identity and memory safely across re-installs.", "show_progress": true}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Care Routine Setup Screen: Insert a new screen before certificate creation where users pick daily interaction style.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_care_routine", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Seal", "body": "Finalize your pet's official records."}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Animated Reveal Flow: Add an extra desktop placement animation screen before completion to demonstrate pet behavior.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_placement_reveal"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Ready for Desktop Launch", "body": "Watch your pet land on your screen and learn quick shortcut triggers.", "button_label": "Watch Companion Spawn"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Progress Pulse: Add a visual step progress indicator and tip carousel to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Press Alt+P anytime to summon your pet to your main cursor.", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Security Notice Copy: Update sign-in body text and hint to emphasize data protection and pet memory persistence.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet's Data & Memory", "body": "Connect your account now so your pet's personality and progress are safely backed up.", "hint": "Your account links your pet's unique traits securely across updates."}}
6: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Companion Trait Highlight: Add bonus trait badges directly to choice cards on the path selection screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "+ Unlock Rare Personality Trait", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidance Hint: Provide real-time quality hints on the upload photos screen for custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, front-facing photos for the crispest 3D pet generation.", "show_step_counter": true}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification opt-in switch while waiting for pet asset rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We'll send a system alert as soon as your companion is ready on screen."}}
9: [finish, layout] Compact Quick Control Overlay Layout: Change home_intro layout to compact layout with direct control command reference.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Active!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to access settings, hide, or talk.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right click: Menu | Double click: Talk | Drag: Move position", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}

answer.reason: Replaces the path options with companion styles, losing the required choice between adopting and making your own pet.
Reordering sign in within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps and jobs.
Adding a new care routine screen inside onboarding is allowed and keeps all required steps intact.
Adding a new screen following home_intro is allowed within onboarding.
Updating waiting screen components with visual progress and tip carousel is permitted.
Updating copy for sign in to explain memory persistence without violating base rules.
Onboarding copy mentions bonus traits and extras (+ Unlock Rare Personality Trait).
Adding photo upload quality guidance hints on upload_photos is allowed.
Enabling notification opt-in during the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning home_intro layout into a compact overlay is allowed.
